objective: Determine whether the frozen T2 tactical reducer can be recognized directly from current-rank support and residual-singleton structure, eliminating ordinary child-state exploration from the candidate Q-V phase factorization.
frozen_t2_reference: W if current mover has an immediate win; otherwise L2 if every legal nonwinning move leaves an immediate opponent win; otherwise O.
candidate_direct_law: Let F be the current legal placement frontier, one open cell per nonfull column.
W iff a current-mover singleton residual lies in F.
Otherwise, for a legal move in column c replace that column's frontier cell by the next cell above it, if any, leaving all other frontier cells unchanged.
The move releases an immediate opponent win iff the resulting frontier intersects the opponent's current singleton-residual cells.
L2 iff every legal move has that intersection; otherwise O.

tests.question: Does the direct current-rank law equal child-derived T2 using exact q_o residuals?
Does the same direct law remain exact after the frozen R/F/G safe-forgetting reduction?

anti_circularity: The direct law uses only current support, current residual singleton cells, and mover/rank.
It does not inspect generated child positions.
The child-derived T2 implementation is used only as an equality oracle after the direct law is frozen.
No W/D/L value labels participate in the direct law.
falsifiers: Any QO_DIRECT mismatch falsifies the proposed rank-local T2 characterization.
Any RFG_DIRECT mismatch shows that safe forgetting removed tactical singleton information needed by this direct reducer, even if QO_DIRECT passes.
nonclaims: A pass establishes recognition of this bounded T2 reducer, not sufficiency of T2 for exact value by itself.
A pass does not establish standard-7x6 qualification.
